finding: Branch 3 states "extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred (§10.2)", but §10.2 (Non-Goal 2) defers a dedicated altitude *reviewer role* ("a fifth default role whose sole lens is altitude is deferred"), not the extension of the un-mechanizable class set. No non-goal actually documents that extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred, so the cited home for that deferral does not exist. A tester writing "verify §10.2 defers extending the un-mechanizable set" gets a contradictory result: §10.2 asserts something else. (The adjacent "un-mechanizable (§5.2, §10.3)" cite is only loosely supported too — §10.3 is about tp not *detecting* over-specification, not about it being excluded from mechanize-check registration — but §10.2 is the clear miss.)
suggestion: Either (a) point the deferral at the correct/actual location, or add an explicit non-goal that defers extending the un-mechanizable class set beyond over-specification and cite that; or (b) drop the "(§10.2)" citation and state the deferral inline in §8.2/§5.2 without claiming a non-goal home it does not have. Also tighten the "un-mechanizable (§10.3)" cite so it points at text that actually establishes the mechanize-registration exclusion (§5.2) rather than the non-detection non-goal.

finding: Branch 3's new parenthetical cites non-goals that do not support its claims. It says over-specification is 'documented as un-mechanizable (§5.2, §10.3); extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred (§10.2)'. But §10.2 defers 'No dedicated altitude reviewer role' (a fifth reviewer role) — it says nothing about an un-mechanizable *class set* or deferring its extension; and §10.3 ('tp does not detect over-specification') is about heuristic detection / orchestrator assertion, not check-registrability. No non-goal in §10 actually defers 'extending the un-mechanizable set', so the cited deferral has no home in the spec and §10.2 is the wrong anchor.
suggestion: Either drop the '(§10.2)' citation and the 'extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred' clause (no §10 non-goal states it), or add a real non-goal deferring extension of the un-mechanizable class set and cite that; retarget the 'un-mechanizable' citation to §5.2 alone (the only place that grounds it as 'not a runnable gate check') and drop §10.3.

finding: The round-20 rewrite of §8.2 branch 3 adds the clause "extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred (§10.2)", but §10.2 is "No dedicated altitude reviewer role" — a non-goal about reviewer roles, not about the set of un-mechanizable finding classes. No non-goal actually defers extension of the un-mechanizable class set, so this cross-reference misdirects a reader who follows it. The clause (and its §10.2 citation) is new in this round; round 19 read "(and any class documented as reviewer-judgement-only) ... (§5.2, §10.3)" with no §10.2 reference or deferral claim.
suggestion: Drop the "extending the un-mechanizable set is deferred (§10.2)" clause (the singleton framing plus §5.2/§10.3 already carries the point), or repoint it to a non-goal that actually states the deferral (adding one to §10 if the deferral is intended to be a recorded non-goal).
